title.ja: 『地動説』, とでも呼ぼうか

1.overview: A gifted young student plans to study theology at university, but his true passion is astronomy. One day, he meets a mysterious scholar named Hubert.

title.ja: 今から, 地球を動かす
title.en: And Now... I`m Going to Move the Earth

2.overview: Rafal is intrigued by Hubert’s heliocentric theory. Later, Hubert is arrested by an inquisitor but he gives Rafal a pendant before being whisked away.

title.ja: 僕は, 地動説を信じてます

3.overview: Nowak convinces Potocki to admit to Rafal's heresy. Once arrested, Rafal is given a choice: recant his belief in heliocentrism or submit to torture.

title.ja: この地球は, 天国なんかよりも美しい
title.en: The Fact That This World Is Far More Beautiful Than Heaven
title.x-jat: Kono Chikyuu wa, Tengoku Nanka yori mo Utsukushii

4.overview: The duelist Oczy wishes for death so he can escape his hopeless world and go to heaven. His colleague finds meaning in life by observing the stars.

title.ja: 私が死んでもこの世界は続く
title.en: Even If I Die... This World Will Continue
title.pl: Nawet gdy umrę, świat będzie dalej istniał
title.x-jat: Watashi ga Shindemo Kono Sekai wa Tsuzuku

5.overview: Gras aborts the mission, placing himself and Oczy in mortal danger from Nowak. They both flee for the mountains, where they find a stone chest.

title.ja: 世界を, 動かせ

6.overview: Oczy seeks the help of Badeni, the demoted monk who incurred the Church's wrath by turning his curiosity to the riddles of the sky.

title.ja: 真理のためなら

7.overview: Gifted scholar Jolenta suffers discrimination as the only girl at an astronomy institute. Badeni seeks resources to prove the heliocentric theory.

title.ja: イカロスにならねば

8.overview: Badeni offers Jolenta a chance to pursue the truth of the skies, but she is overcome with fear. Afterward, she overhears bold words from Count Piast.

title.ja: きっとそれが, 何かを知るということだ
title.en: This Is What It Means... to Learn Something, I Think
title.x-jat: Kitto Sore ga, Nanika o Shiru to Iu Koto Da

9.overview: A middle-aged Piast vows to prove his professor's geocentric model. In the present, he agrees to let Badeni use his records — on one condition.

10.overview: Oczy tells Badeni that he is learning to read and write. Later, Badeni's claim that knowledge should be held by a select few bothers a fellow monk.

11.overview: Nowak gives two rookie inquisitors a terrifying first taste of their new roles. Badeni meets with Jolenta and tells her he has completed his theory.

title.ja: 俺は, 地動説を信仰してる
title.x-jat: Ore wa, Chidousetsu o Shinkou Shiteru

12.overview: Nowak asks Badeni to show him his research. He inspects Badeni’s premises but doesn’t find anything incriminating — until he spots a certain item.

title.ja: 『自由』を

13.overview: In a medical area within the inquisition chamber, a wounded Oczy awakes to see Nowak, who has kept him alive in hopes of extracting information.

title.ja: 今日のこの空は

14.overview: Badeni must choose between revealing the location of the heretical documents on heliocentric theory or prolonging Oczy’s torture at Nowak’s hands.

title.ja: 私の, 番なのか?
title.x-jat: Watashi no, Ban na no ka?

15.overview: Nowak believes his beloved daughter has been executed as a heretic. Father Grabowski comes across a letter from Badeni containing an unusual request.

title.ja: 行動を開始する
title.en: It`s Time to Begin the Operation

16.overview: Twenty-five years later, Captain Schmidt of the extremist Heretic Liberation Front infiltrates a church and steals an important item.

title.ja: この本で大稼ぎできる, かも
title.en: I Could Make a Lot of Money with This Book... Maybe
title.pl: Zbiłabym fortunę na tej księdze… chyba
title.x-jat: Kono Hon de Ookasegi Dekiru, kamo

17.overview: A young nomad woman haunted by poverty devotes her life to obtaining wealth. One night, she discovers the book that Frei hid in the abandoned village.

title.ja: 情報を解放する

18.overview: Bishop Antoni orders Draka to hand over the book, but Schmidt’s men suddenly intervene. Determined to change her fate, she takes a bold action.

title.ja: 迷いの中に倫理がある
title.en: Wandering Is How You Find What`s Right
title.x-jat: Mayoi no Naka ni Rinri ga Aru

19.overview: Hoping to track down the people who stole the book, an inquisitor seeks advice from Nowak, who now spends his days drowning his sorrows.

title.ja: 私は, 地動説を愛している
title.x-jat: Watashi wa, Chidousetsu o Ai Shite Iru

20.overview: As the Heretic Liberation Front prepares to depart, Jolenta entrusts Draka with a letter. Soon after, Nowak and the inquisitors approach the barn.

title.ja: 時代は変わる

21.overview: Schmidt and the others regroup with their Liberation Front comrades and begin printing the book. However, a traitor brings their operation to a halt.

title.ja: 君らは歴史の登場人物じゃない
title.en: Neither of You Will Be Known to History
title.x-jat: Kimira wa Rekishi no Toujou Jinbutsu ja Nai

22.overview: As Nowak's group attacks the Liberation Front, Draka and Schmidt begin their escape. Upon reaching town, Draka makes a proposition to Bishop Antoni.

title.ja: 同じ時代を作った仲間

23.overview: A deluded Nowak turns against Antoni and attempts to burn down the church. Draka fights back and escapes but incurs a terrible wound.

title.ja: タウマゼインを

24.overview: Albert goes to deliver an order of bread to a church. While there, he encounters a mysterious priest who encourages him to confess his sins.

25.overview: Albert leaves the academic gathering and returns home to an awful sight. In the present, the priest gives Albert advice and makes his own confession.

title.en: Orb: On the Movements of the Earth in 5 Minutes
